reason: The non-list branch returns a body-less `Response(status=HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY)` at src/sentry/issues/endpoints/browser_reporting_collector.py:104, while a per-report validation failure returns a 422 with a JSON `{"error", "details"}` body at :115-118, so the two 422 formats differ. One detail of the claim is off: the old code had no empty-body 422 for invalid list items, since `BrowserReport(**report)` would raise instead.
